name: Hexagon 1
description: v1's Hexagon 1: a honeycomb of 412 tiny nuclei (4 up + 2 down quarks, nuclear charge alternating ±1 around each hexagon), tilted 20°, bound by v1's sine nuclear force (range 500) against Coulomb (k = 1/60). Three rows of 500 electrons with alternating nuclear charge fly in from the left at speed 200 and hit the lattice from t ≈ 75. Gravity (G = 1e-6) is negligible and omitted.
